title: Agentic AI 2026: Why Every Lab Moved at Once
description: Agentic AI 2026: in four weeks Google, OpenAI and Anthropic shipped agent models at $2/$10, cut cache prices, moved into AWS, and OpenAI cut Pro allowances.

attribution.citation: Json House, "Agentic AI 2026: Why Every Lab Moved at Once", jsonhouse.com (2026-10-05)

key_facts.fact: Gemini 4 Argon, announced 2026-09-30, raises the output limit from 64,000 to 1 million tokens and is priced at an introductory $2 input / $10 output per 1M tokens with cached input 95% off, rising to $4 / $20 afterwards; the end date of the introductory rate is not published
Four tracked models sit at exactly $2 input / $10 output per 1M tokens on 2026-10-05 — Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6-sol and GPT-6.1-sol — against one (Claude Sonnet 5) on 2026-07-16
key_facts.source: jsonhouse weekly pricing snapshot series, 2026-07-16 and 2026-10-05

key_facts.fact: Until 2026-09-01 the only tracked models pricing a cache read below 0.1x of their own input price were DeepSeek's; by 2026-10-05 four US models had followed (Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1-sol)
key_facts.source: jsonhouse weekly pricing snapshot series, 2026-07-16 through 2026-10-05

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's cheapest sol model cost 11.5x DeepSeek v4-pro's off-peak input price on 2026-07-16 and 3.0x on 2026-10-05; the gap closed from both sides, with the sol input price down 60% and DeepSeek v4-pro up 52%
key_facts.source: jsonhouse derived from weekly pricing snapshots of OpenAI and DeepSeek official pricing pages

key_facts.fact: Anthropic measured AI agents using about 4x the tokens of chat interactions and multi-agent systems about 15x, and found token usage alone explained 80% of performance variance in its browsing evaluation
key_facts.source: Anthropic Engineering, multi-agent research system, June 2025

key_facts.fact: OpenAI reopened ChatGPT Pro 200 on 2026-09-29 at an unchanged $200 per month with a lower usage allowance for new subscriptions; eligible existing subscribers keep the previous allowance only through 2026-10-29. OpenAI's pages do not state the size of the reduction
key_facts.source: OpenAI Help Center, About ChatGPT Pro tiers, retrieved 2026-10-05

key_facts.fact: GPT-6 Astra became generally available on Amazon Bedrock on 2026-09-08 and GPT-6 Sol and Luna on 2026-09-22; Claude Platform became available inside AWS accounts on 2026-05-11

Meta uses interactions with Meta AI to personalize content and ads from 2025-12-16, excluding topics such as religious views, sexual orientation, political views and health from ad targeting; Meta states more than 1 billion people use Meta AI monthly

Anthropic's consumer terms let Claude Free, Pro and Max users choose whether their chats train models, with 5-year retention if allowed and 30 days if not, and do not apply to API or commercial use including via Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
key_facts.source: Anthropic, Updates to Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy, August 28, 2025

faq_summary.q: Why is agentic AI taking off in 2026?
faq_summary.a: Three things changed in the same four weeks: models built for long-horizon work shipped, the cache-read price agents mostly pay fell below 10% of input at four US models, and US models became purchasable inside AWS accounts.

faq_summary.q: What is Gemini 4 Argon and how much does it cost?
faq_summary.a: Google's frontier model announced 2026-09-30 with a 1-million-token output limit. Introductory pricing is $2 / $10 per 1M tokens with cached input 95% off, then $4 / $20; the end date is not published.

faq_summary.q: Did OpenAI raise the price of ChatGPT Pro?
faq_summary.a: Not the price. Pro 200 stays at $200 a month, but new subscriptions not eligible for grandfathering get a lower allowance, and eligible subscribers keep the previous one only through 2026-10-29. OpenAI's pages do not state the size of the cut.

faq_summary.q: Why does the cache price matter more than the list price for AI agents?
faq_summary.a: Agents re-send instructions, tools and history on every step, using about 4x the tokens of a chat. On that volume the cache-read price decides the bill.

faq_summary.q: Will AI agents use my personal data for ads or training?
faq_summary.a: It depends on the tier. Meta uses Meta AI interactions for content and ad personalization; Anthropic lets consumers choose on training and exempts API and commercial use; enterprise agents on Amazon Bedrock are processed inside Bedrock.
